controls.name: always-change and never-change diagnostics
controls.role: Required degenerate boundary controls that expose metric behavior; they are not product candidates and were not run on a valid change-point cohort.

controls.name: speaker-change boundary versus any-speech utterance boundary
controls.role: Utterance onset/offset and speaker change are different events; a VAD boundary score cannot establish speaker-change accuracy or segment purity.

controls.name: unknown-region masking
controls.role: Unannotated time is excluded, never relabelled nonspeech, no-change or a single-speaker segment.

controls.name: single-speaker, two-speaker and multi-turn strata
controls.role: Boundary error and segment purity must be reported by turn and speaker-count stratum; aggregate accuracy alone hides merged and split turns.

controls.name: identity / passthrough audio
controls.role: Change detection never modifies PCM; an identity control guards against a gate, separator or diarizer being credited as a segmenter.

controls.name: declared window, hop, lookahead and collar
controls.role: A change-point result needs the exact analysis window, hop, lookahead, matching collar and timestamp convention; an undeclared policy is not comparable.

controls.name: synthetic speaker-turn mixture versus natural change
controls.role: Constructed additive turns test robustness but do not substitute for naturally occurring speaker changes or locally homogeneous segment truth.

controls.name: any-speech VAD activity control
controls.role: A speech-activity detector is a baseline for utterance onset/offset behavior, not a speaker-change detector or diarizer.

controls.name: missing, invalid, nonfinite and out-of-range interval rejection
controls.role: Missing or malformed change points and segments are blocked, not scored; no missing result may qualify a candidate or produce a boundary claim.
